description: ImplementedSCCM_Lighting satisfies EL-HAZ-1.1 (SCCM_Lighting_HazardWarning) and EL-RSP-1.1 (SCCM_Lighting_IndicatorResponseTime): the input mappings copy the evdev button and stalk values to the HazardLightButton and TurnStalk restbus frames through lookup transforms only, and driver_can.dbc sends those frames every 50 ms.
**Not claimed:** EL-BEAM-1.1 (SCCM_Lighting_BeamModes). The MOZA mappings meet it, the Logitech G29 mapping does not (EL_Beam_Mode_Review.md).
metadata.name: SatisfactionClaim_NonSafety_ImplementedSCCM_Lighting
